kit.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the MERN Developer - Intern position at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies Private Limited in Bangalore. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on full-stack development experience, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your engineering team and transition into a full-time role.

During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready system using Node.js, Express, and MySQL, implementing secure authentication and role-based access control. Additionally, my personal projects include Zenvest, a trading platform built across the MERN stack featuring JWT-based authentication and server-side request validation, and StaySphere, an Airbnb-style property rental platform using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB with Passport.js authentication.

My background aligns closely with the MERN stack requirements of this role, and I am well-prepared to build scalable, high-performance web applications. I am based in Bangalore and eager to bring my technical skills and dedication to Nxtwave.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background fits your team's needs.

Sincerely,
Amaanuddin Ahmed
